notes: Needs ruling (rule 11, two sayings in one report): the Umm Habiba report («حديث العلاء بن الحارث عن مكحول عن عنبسة بن أبي سفيان عن أم حبيبة») is a second saying with its own isnad; it is not added as a group
The second group («حدثنا بذلك، علي بن حجر») carries the same saying («نحوه») and is a second isnad, not a variant
Al-Tirmidhi's remarks («قال محمد», «وقال أبو زرعة») are commentary, not chain; «غير واحد» is an opinion, not a transmitter
